User Reviews

☆☆☆☆☆
Colourful chaos awaits in our 2016 iPhone Game of the Year. Supercell’s awesome card battler delivers excellent deck-building mechanics and fast-paced fights in a package that’s easy to understand and undeniably fun. Upgrading, unlocking and experimenting with cards gives the game endless replayability, and deciding just where to drop your heroes makes each battle distinct. But no matter how good your deck is, there’s no substitute for skill and quick thinking.

★★★★★ 2021-01-14
War is still broken
I have a love/hate relationship with this game but it is still my single favorite mobile game. However, the matchmaking in War is beyond broken. Probably half the time, I am playing decks with an average level 2-3 higher than mine. I’m not sure that I have ever written a game review but I am hoping Supercell’s developers hear enough reviews like this to actually make a change. It is all but impossible to overcome a deck with all level 13 when you have a mix of 10 and 11. It’s gotten to the point that I usually just quit as soon as it becomes obvious that the person I am playing against isn’t terrible because I just have nearly 0% chance to win otherwise. Not only do they have better cards typically, I will go and check the player profile afterwards and they often have many more trophies than I do. You know a matchmaking system is broken when you are consistently outgunned and compete against players with higher achievements/skill in the game. I really can’t make sense of the matchmaking algorithm. I am sure they put a ton of work into it but it is about as bad as it gets. This is only in reference to war. Single player matchmaking is actually pretty good. As background, I actually play 6 accounts ranging from 4300 trophies on my lowest to a high of 5800 on my best account. The only reason I even play war is to get points for my clan and because I don’t want to let them down. I HATE having to play war and definitely wouldn’t if I wasn’t in a clan. Supercell, PLEASE FIX.
★★★★★ 2023-04-04
Update For Loser’s
When it comes to clash Royale I have been playing for quite some time now and what I have seen in terms of progression is that it’s very challenging to get level 14 cards, and I understand that you did this on purpose because they are so powerful. But when I think of progressing the one thing that helped me get my cards to higher levels faster and easier was the pass Royale. The pass allowed me to win around 50 matches in each season and I would then earn enough crowns to get pretty far in which then unlocked tons of chests and wildcards and if I decided to play even more it even granted me a few legendary cards. But with the latest update you guys have made the diamond pass. I think that the diamond pass ruins progression for free to play users because it simply made it so you guys had to also nerf the gold pass and the rewards that you unlock for free and you even made it harder to progress to the free rewards by merging the tiers. When I think of a battle pass I think of fortnite or apex legends where they separate the free rewards and the payed rewards so you can see everything you can get and it’s the same to progress the payed and the free versions. This is exactly how you used to do it so who’s to say you couldn’t make a 3rd separation and have 3 lines showcasing each of the rewards for the gold and diamond pass? I believe this would help you make money while also keeping the game fun and less demanding of you to spend money in order to level up your cards.Sincerely, Hunter

From the creators of CLASH OF CLANS comes a real-time multiplayer battle game starring your favourite Clash characters and more. Start battling against players from around the world! BECOME A MASTER OF STRATEGY AND DECK BUILDING Choose unique Cards to your Battle Deck and head to the Arena for Battle! Place your Cards right and knock down the enemy King and Princesses from their Towers in a strategic and fast-paced match. COLLECT AND UPGRADE 100+ CARDS Hog Rider! Collect and upgrade 100+ Cards featuring the Clash of Clans troops, spells and defences you know and love and many others. Win battles and progress to new Arenas to unlock powerful new Cards to your collection! BATTLE YOUR WAY TO THE TOP Battle your way to the League and Global Tournaments to match against the best players in the world. Compete for glory and rewards! SEASONAL EVENTS Unlock new Seasonal items like Tower Skins, Emotes and powerful Magic Items with the Season Pass and participate in fun Challenges that put your skills to the test! JOIN A CLAN AND GO TO WAR Join or form a Clan with other players to share Cards and battle in Clan Wars for BIG rewards! See you in the Arena! PLEASE NOTE! Clash Royale is free to download and play, however, some game items can also be purchased for real money. If you don't want to use this feature, please disable in-app purchases in your device's settings. The game also includes random rewards.
